description: Real ferrum-migrate CLI contract (src/ferrum_migration/cli.py): `convert INPUT --from kong|nginx|traefik|envoy|istio --out DIR [--include-secrets] [--assert-traefik-input-includes-effective-controls]`. The Traefik statement is passed only for cases that name it in converter_assertions (their synthetic source is served by the file provider alone, on one plaintext loopback entryPoint with no TLS, middlewares, redirections or forwarded-header settings, so the input holds every effective routing, TLS and access control); without it the converter refuses every forwarding Traefik route. DB-less kong.yml and decK dumps share one schema and both use `--from kong`; there is no --kong-format flag, and the report's `kong-input-flavor` caveat states which flavor was detected. Output names are fixed: resources.yaml (or resources.json with --resources-format json), ferrum.conf, migration-report.json/.md, plus .gitignore when credentials were written. Exit codes: 0 migrated without error findings, 4 written but review required (the report has error findings), 3 input rejected (nothing written), 1 internal error, 2 usage error, 5 output not writable safely.
